requirements.evidence: Both migrations match the contract: `database/migrations/2026_10_29_035752_create_entities_table.php:14-17` (slug unique `entities_slug_unique`, timestamps, softDeletes) and `..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-27` (`owner_seq` `storedAs("case when role = 'owner' then 1 else null end")`, unique `entity_memberships_one_owner` and `entity_memberships_entity_user_unique`, role default employee). Policies implement the matrix (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:12-49`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-45`, owner never deletable/reassignable). Pick authorizes before writing the session and audits (`app/Http/Controllers/EntityPickController.php:18-26`); transfer is transactional, demotes before promoting, and 403s on missing owner/self/non-admin (`app/Actions/TransferOwnership.php:25-36`); duplicate member is an `email` error (`app/Actions/AddMember.php:29`), last-manager removal throws 403 (`app/Actions/RemoveMember.php:24-31`); owner-only settings link/nav (`resources/views/components/entity-nav.blade.php:6-8`) and the exact pt_BR/en strings incl. `nav_members`/`nav_settings` (`lang/pt_BR/ui.php:52-53`, `lang/en/ui.php:53-54`) are present; `docs/database-schema.md` and `CHANGELOG.md:9-10` updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through one Action class each with authorization inside (`app/Actions/AddMember.php:22`, `AssignRole.php:21`, `RemoveMember.php:22`, `TransferOwnership.php:25`, `UpdateEntity.php:18`, `DeleteEntity.php:18`); `#[Validate]` used in components (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:28`, `Settings.php:22`); deliberate `#[Fillable]` (`app/Models/Entity.php:14`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:14`); reusable markup extracted into an anonymous component (`resources/views/components/entity-nav.blade.php`); Bulma classes and `{{ }}` only; migrations have reversible `down()` methods; docs/CHANGELOG kept in sync. One deviation: `Settings::$targetMembershipId` is client input with no `#[Validate]`/rule and `transfer()` never calls `$this->validate()` (`app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:27`).

security.evidence: Every entry point authorizes server-side: mount (`Dashboard.php:19`, `Members.php:32`, `Settings.php:31`), actions (`Members.php:37-66`, `Settings.php:40,52,65`) and the action classes themselves. The entity is `#[Locked]` in all three components (`Dashboard.php:13-14`, `Members.php:24-25`, `Settings.php:20-21`), client-passed membership ids are re-scoped to the bound entity (`Members.php:92-100`), transfer resolves the target inside the entity and requires admin (`TransferOwnership.php:28-33`), pick leaves the session untouched on 403 (`EntityPickController.php:18-20`), input is validated (`Members.php:28`, `Settings.php:22,84`), views escape with `{{ }}`, and `$fillable` prevents mass assignment.

tests.evidence: Six Pest files cover the model/DB invariants (`tests/Feature/Entities/DataModelTest.php:30` second owner, named indexes), policies (`PolicyTest.php` incl. `:101` owner never reassigned), pick (`PickEntityTest.php` incl. `:30` 403 + session untouched), dashboard (`DashboardTest.php`), members (`MembersTest.php:98` employee 403, `:174` tampered foreign id, `:240` last manager) and settings (`SettingsTest.php:202` locked entity, `:152` transfer, delete/slug cases). Gaps: `delete()`/`transfer()` have no direct unauthorized-call test (only mount-level `assertForbidden` at `SettingsTest.php:131`), Members lacks a tamper test for its locked `$entity`, and the `name` rule is never exercised.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing pieces (`x-form-field`/`x-button`, `UserRole::manageable()`, `EntityMembership` scopes) and avoids needless abstraction. However six Action classes include very thin wrappers (`UpdateEntity.php:18-21` is authorize + `update()`), and authorization is duplicated component-side and action-side (`Settings.php:40` vs `UpdateEntity.php:18`, `Members.php:37` vs `AddMember.php:22`), which adds ceremony beyond what the feature needs.

readability.evidence: Small, typed, single-purpose methods with useful PHPDoc (`app/Models/Entity.php:23-54`, `EntityMembership.php:23-61`, `TransferOwnership.php:15-39`); the non-obvious owner invariant is explained in place (`..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:22-24`, `TransferOwnership.php:35`); components keep rendering data in `render()` (`Members.php:79-85`, `Settings.php:74-80`); names match the domain; no dead code or debugging output.

scope.evidence: All files belong to the entities feature; no unrelated refactors, no onboarding/switcher/session-guard/navbar changes (explicitly out of scope). Small extras: audit lines added to add/assign/remove/delete/transfer although only `entity.pick` requires one (`app/Actions/AddMember.php:33`, `AssignRole.php:30`, `RemoveMember.php:36`, `DeleteEntity.php:25`, `TransferOwnership.php:40`), plus session clearing/redirect on self-removal (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:66-75`).

issues.explanation: `$targetMembershipId` is client-writable user input but has no `#[Validate]` attribute or rule and `transfer()` never calls `$this->validate()`, deviating from the project's 'validate public properties' rule; safety currently relies only on the action's lookup and authorization.

The admin case only asserts `assertForbidden()` at mount; there is no direct unauthorized call to `delete()` (nor a non-owner `transfer()` call), which the conventions require for every Livewire action.

Members has no tamper test showing the `#[Locked]` `$entity` cannot be swapped, unlike the Settings equivalent, so the 'tamper attempt on a locked value' requirement is only covered by the foreign-membership test.

Authorization is repeated in the component and again inside the Action for save/delete/transfer; the component-side pre-check is only needed for add/assign to return 403 before validation, so the rest is redundant ceremony.

Audit logging was added to add/assign/remove/delete/transfer although the task only requires the `entity.pick` audit line, and self-removal additionally clears the session and redirects (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:66-75`) - small unrequested behaviour.

The updated diagram declares `int owner_seq` while the migration uses `unsignedTinyInteger` (`database/migrations/2026_10_29_035753_create_entity_memberships_table.php:21`), a small doc/code mismatch.

review.summary: The change builds the entities/memberships data model with the generated-column one-owner constraint, policies, slug-routed Livewire dashboard/members/settings pages, pick endpoint with audit logging, translations, docs and a broad Pest suite. Requirements and security are fully met, including the tricky cases (session untouched on 403, owner row vanished, duplicate member, last manager, cross-entity ID tampering, locked entity). The overall score is 4 because of a few nits: an unvalidated public `targetMembershipId`, missing direct unauthorized/tamper tests for some actions, duplicated authorization and some unrequested audit/redirect behaviour.
